tokenCases.name: empty string
ascii whitespace only
plain words
structural punctuation attaches to its word
every punctuation char counts
U+3000 ideographic space does NOT split
U+00A0 no-break space does NOT split
U+FEFF BOM does NOT split
U+2028 / U+2029 line+paragraph separators do NOT split
U+2002 / U+200A en+hair spaces do NOT split
U+1680 / U+202F / U+205F do NOT split
vertical tab and form feed DO split
CRLF splits once, not twice
lone CR splits
U+0085 NEL does NOT split (JS \s has it, the ASCII class does not)

realistic payload: root line, header, CJK comment, code
astral char counts as two UTF-16 code units
trailing newline still counts the final empty line
CRLF counts one line break, lone CR counts none
